name: method
value: Constant-elasticity demand with an assumed 60% exchange-rate pass-through. All indices use a baseline of 100. Positive FX change means depreciation: more local currency per US dollar.

name: formula
value: Producer price = 1 − 0.6d/(1+d); buyer price = (1+t) × producer price; quantity = buyer price^(−ε); USD receipts = producer price × quantity; local receipts = USD receipts × (1+d).

name: limits
value: The 60% coefficient is synthetic. There is no supply response, competitor response, capacity constraint or fitted trade dataset. These are scenario indices, not an official forecast.
